reviews.text:
Very finely milled, works for under eyes as well as the rest of the face, easy and cute to carry around and if you’re oily like me I really recommend.

It doesn’t have noticeable pigment in it so it should work for everyone I think.
reviews.zh:
研磨得好幼細，眼周同臉上其他位置都用得，攜帶方便又可愛，如果你好油嘅話，我真係好推薦。

我覺得佢冇明顯色素，所以應該人人都用得。

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The Flower Knows Setting Powder Keychain is the perfect blend of cute and practical! The packaging is absolutely adorable and compact enough to clip onto a bag or carry in a small purse, making touch-ups super convenient throughout the day. The powder feels lightweight, helps control shine without looking cakey, and leaves my skin with a soft, smooth finish. I also love that it doesn’t feel heavy or dry on the skin. It’s such a fun little beauty accessory that’s both functional and aesthetically beautiful—definitely worth having if you love cute makeup with great performance!
reviews.zh:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The Flower Knows Setting Powder Keychain 真係可愛同實用兼備！包裝超可愛，夠細，可以扣喺袋上或者放入細袋，令補妝好方便，一日都得。粉質輕盈，有助控油，唔會有卡粉感，皮膚感覺柔滑、平滑。我亦鍾意佢唔會令皮膚覺得沉重或者乾燥。佢係一件好有趣嘅化妝小配件，既實用又好睇，如果你鍾意可愛嘅化妝品又表現好，絕對值得擁有！

reviews.text: It's very cute but that's pretty much all there is to it. It doesn't work very well
reviews.zh: 好可愛，但係基本上就只係咁。效果唔係好好。

reviews.text:
It's a good powder, but is it the best? No, but it also doesn't need to be, I see this more of a reapplying tool, and for that it's good enough. 
It's also cool that it's a keychain, although I'm not brave enough to carry it around on my bag.
reviews.zh:
係一款好嘅粉，但係係咪最好？唔係，但係亦唔使咁好，我覺得佢更似補妝工具，而呢方面就夠好。
而且佢係鎖匙扣，好酷，不過我唔夠膽掛住佢喺袋上四處走。

reviews.text: the keychain is so cute and pretty it's a cookie heart shaped🍪💗, the powder is nice as well it comes with a small puf but i didn't like the smell of the powder it's honestly bad idk :( (4 stars for the cute keychain)
reviews.zh: 鎖匙扣好可愛、好靚，係一個心形餅乾嘅造型🍪💗，粉都幾好，附有一個細粉撲，但係我唔鍾意粉嘅味道，老實講好差，唔知點解 :( （鎖匙扣畀 4 星）

reviews.text: dalle foto non sembra ma e bello grandicello,lo provato e mi asciuga subito,la chiusura e con la calamita,molto pratica la mini puff da dito,che dire super fantastica,bella da vedere e sfoggiare su qualche borsetta e perché no anche come ciondolo da mettere sul giubbotto
reviews.zh: 相上睇唔出，但係其實幾大個。我試過，佢好快乾身。扣口係磁石，好方便；個迷你指撲好實用，講真超正！好靚，可以掛喺手袋上展示，又或者當吊飾掛喺夾克上。

reviews.text: This powder has a very cute and practical design, perfect for being carried in a purse or attach it to your bag. The packaging is very well made and it’s perfect as a gift. I bought the cookie one, the powder is translucent and leaves a matte finish without being cakey.
reviews.zh: 呢款粉嘅設計好可愛、好實用，適合放喺手袋或者掛喺袋上。包裝做得好好，好適合用嚟送禮。我買咗餅乾版，粉係半透明，塗完會有啞光效果，唔會卡粉。

reviews.text: The lilac tone for 01 Cocoa is very subtle, so it’s pretty much like a translucent powder and doesn’t really have a colour correcting effect. The powder is very finely milled, and makes the skin look very matte and blurred. The packaging is super cute, but it’s kind of heavy. The pan size for the powder is also tiny. It comes with a tiny puff which is surprisingly soft, and also a mirror inside.
reviews.zh: 01 Cocoa 嘅紫色調好淡，所以基本上就似半透明粉，冇咩顏色修飾效果。粉質非常幼細，令皮膚睇落好啞光、柔焦。包裝好可愛，但係幾重。粉格都好細。附有一個細粉撲，好出奇地軟，仲有一面入面嘅小鏡子。
